material_fused_families.result: WP02 decoded string identity improved; stale optional-placeholder representation strongly explains the first V9/V17 failure; exact current Hostinger blob supports the placeholder fix on matched fixtures, but full repaired WP02 closure remains open and WP03 stays gated.

Architecture advances from row retrieval toward an always-available provenance-bound possibility/semantic preprocessor with seed fastpaths, rebuildable ClayGraph projections, explicit separation of graph activation from proof eligibility, coherent generation publication, fast-vs-legacy differentials and ambiguity gates.

On a deterministic synthetic 10-query/400-distractor fixture, flat lexical retrieval measured 0.8833 required-evidence recall and 0.30 top-1 intended affordance; the possibility preprocessor measured 1.00 and 1.00. This is correlated synthetic component evidence only, not global database superiority or live-FRANK outcome evidence.
